blocks.text: Cottonwood Maple Ridge Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Cottonwood is a board sub-area name only — the City does not list Cottonwood among its neighbourhoods and publishes no Cottonwood area plan or street-by-street boundary.

The area's official anchors are Kanaka Creek Elementary at 11120 234A Street and Alexander Robinson Elementary at 11849 238B Street, west of 240 Street and east of the Town Centre, with Kanaka Creek running through it to the Fraser River.
Albion lies east beyond 240 Street, the Town Centre and East Central lie west, and Thornhill lies north.

blocks.text: Cottonwood Maple Ridge Houses: the housing stock

items.t: With no area plan, Cottonwood's detached stock is ordinary RS-zone subdivision housing under Zoning Bylaw No.
No secondary school stands inside the sub-area; the two schools inside it are both Kindergarten to Grade 7 elementaries, Kanaka Creek and Alexander Robinson.

blocks.text: Cottonwood Maple Ridge Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The rule that matters most on Cottonwood lots is the creek: Kanaka Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse protected inside Kanaka Creek Regional Park, so lots backing onto the creek corridor carry watercourse setbacks that interior lots do not.

blocks.text: Cottonwood Maple Ridge Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The waste and recycling address for this side of town is in the sub-area's backyard: Metro Vancouver's Maple Ridge Recycling and Waste Centre and the free Ridge Meadows Recycling Depot are both at 10092 236 Street.

Kanaka Creek Regional Park's trails are the local recreation system here — the Canyon Trail runs from the fish hatchery to Cliff Falls at 1.2 km one way and the Riverfront Trails run 3 km one way at the creek oxbow and the Fraser River.

No City recreation centre or library branch sits in Cottonwood; the Maple Ridge Leisure Centre is at 11925 Haney Place and Maple Ridge Public Library is at 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, both in the Town Centre.

blocks.text: Cottonwood Maple Ridge Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Garbage is a private contract here, not a City service: Maple Ridge residents choose their own garbage disposal service, while curbside recycling through Recycle BC is provided at no cost to residents.

blocks.text: Cottonwood Maple Ridge Houses: getting around

items.t: Cottonwood's transit is the 745 Haney Place / Cottonwood circular, interlining with the 746 to Albion at Jackson Road at 103 Avenue — there is no West Coast Express station in the sub-area.
Local streets named in TransLink routing for this area include 232 Street, 238B Street, Kanaka Way, 240 Street and 104 Avenue, linking the house streets to Haney Place Exchange in the Town Centre.
East–west driving is on Lougheed Highway to the south and Dewdney Trunk Road to the north of the sub-area.

blocks.text: Cottonwood Maple Ridge Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Creek-side lots are the due-diligence priority: Metro Vancouver flags steep, slippery cliffs along Kanaka Creek at Cliff Falls, and the park corridor means setback and slope questions on any lot backing onto the creek.
Flood status for a specific Cottonwood lot is read under Floodplain Management Bylaw No.

blocks.text: Cottonwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

55 houses sold in Cottonwood with a median price of $1,195,000 (the middle half sold between $1,079,500 and $1,346,000), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $421 per square foot, a median year built of 2002 and a median lot of 5,995 square feet.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Cottonwood, Maple Ridge

Right against the greenbelt, Cottonwood is a family subdivision. Streets back onto Kanaka Creek Regional Park, Alexander Robinson Elementary on 238B Street sits in the middle of the houses, and Cliff Falls on the Canyon Trail is the local walk.
